title: Single-cell update during write sweep
statement: Let $Ninmathbb{N}$, let $E$ inject the symbols of an alphabet $Gamma$ together with blank into blocks of $N+1$ optional bits, let $t:bb{Z}tomathrm{Option}Gamma$ be a tape, and let $pinbb{Z}$ and $winmathrm{Option}Gamma$. For any offset $jin{0,dots,N}$, replacing the binary tape induced by the counter-$(j+1)$ write-sweep family at position $(N+1)p+j$ with the $j$th bit-or-blank entry of $E(w)$ gives exactly the binary tape induced by the counter-$j$ family.
replaced:
For $j \in \{0,\dots,N\}$, overwriting the binary tape induced by the counter-$(j+1)$
partially rewritten block family (tape $t$, write position $p$, new symbol $w$) at
tape position $(N+1)p + j$ with entry $j$ of the code of $w$ yields the binary tape
induced by the counter-$j$ family: blocks other than $p$ are unchanged, and within
block $p$ the only new entry is the one at offset $j$.
